text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph development with examples","quality":"idea development","description":"It explains points with more developed examples and fuller elaboration rather than repeating the same basic claim."},{"evidence":"clear transitions like \"The first reason\" and \"The second reason\"","quality":"organization","description":"It uses a more explicit structure to guide the reader through its reasons and conclusion."},{"evidence":"longer, more complete sentences","quality":"syntactic control","description":"It shows greater control of sentence-building, with more varied and extended sentence forms."},{"evidence":"\"I partnered up with a girl in our math class\" and \"I told her she can be my friend\"","quality":"narrative detail","description":"It includes more specific, concrete details that make the examples feel more fully realized."},{"evidence":"\"made them smile\", \"make them learn\", \"the act will come back to you\"","quality":"summative clarity","description":"It ends with a clearer restatement of its main points in a concluding sentence."}]}
